notes: Feature extraction cost is NOT included in these timings.

resource_profiling.scope: model predict/testing only; model training, feature extraction, data loading, tuning, serialization, graphing and report generation are excluded
resource_profiling.process_scope: current process plus recursive child processes
resource_profiling.cpu_definition: aggregate process-tree user+system CPU seconds; average utilization = 100 * CPU seconds / wall seconds; may exceed 100 for parallel workloads
resource_profiling.memory_definition: aggregate process-tree RSS bytes sampled during workload; shared pages can be counted by more than one process
